traceability.notes: Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION is fully implemented and verified. The ESLint rule traceability/valid-story-reference, together with storyReferenceUtils and valid-story-reference-helpers, implements all specified requirements: it parses @story annotations; resolves paths relative to the project root (via context.cwd or process.cwd) and configured storyDirectories; enforces the .story.md extension when required; prevents path traversal and disallowed absolute paths; enforces project boundaries even when storyDirectories are misconfigured; caches filesystem checks for performance; and distinguishes missing files from filesystem errors, reporting clear diagnostics with path and error context. Comprehensive Jest/RuleTester tests in tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts cover happy paths, misconfigurations, boundary conditions, and error-handling behavior, and they all pass in the current test run. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md provides rule semantics, configuration, and examples consistent with the story. All acceptance criteria for this story are therefore satisfied.
